allowedOrigins.title: Allowed LinkNest origins
allowedOrigins.description: Exact http(s) origins (scheme + host + port) that may request this browser profile’s bookmarks. Paths are ignored. Empty means fail-closed unless org-branding.json lists origins.

syncDefaultOn.title: Default Bookmark sync On for new profiles
syncDefaultOn.description: If true, Bookmark sync starts On until the user toggles it. Default is false (opt-in).
